description: Store a single memory record in Memoreal Cloud (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent: encoding identical text twice creates separate IDs until consolidate is run) and return { id, namespace, salience }. Defaults type to "episodic", salience to 0.5 (items >=0.7 or semantic/core surface in memory://rules), and namespace to "default" while rejecting reserved "org:" prefixes. Use when persisting one architectural decision, bug root cause, or user rule; use batch_encode instead for 2+ memories at once, or handoff_to_agent for cross-wing task handoffs.

context.description: Optional [key, value] string pairs (for example [["file", "src/auth.js"]]) targetable by delete_by_context.

namespace.description: Logical project or workspace namespace (defaults to "default"; never prefix with "org:").

salience.description: Importance weight from 0.0 to 1.0 (use >=0.7 for durable team rules).

type.description: Memory tier classification (core and semantic receive 1.5x/1.25x recall boosts).

name: encode_memory
title: Encode Memory
